title.subtitle: The audit firehose, banded. Signal is what the forensic dashboards show.

url.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL band = CASE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance"), "infra-noise", attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context", "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "connection_granted", "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "authentication_success", "authn-volume", "signal") | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY ts = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), band | SORT ts ASC
